pools.name: mainnet-pusd-pool
pools.notes: FIRST mainnet shielded pool op. Same circuit (183,472 constraints, 2 public inputs) + covenant as the chipnet runs, solo 1-of-1 ceremony (entropy published). PREP dd1e3506…0e7d (category), GENESIS 0a8cb008…c5c4 (state NFT, commitment = root || nullifier-set hash), DEPLOY 63ddfdd4…af7c (covenant + 5 verifier steps + 100 base units (1.00 PUSD) holdings), TRANSFER 4fda8a8b…544f (real Groth16 proof, 100 base units (1.00 PUSD) conserved, 38,475 B, 1 sat/B). All 7 inputs VM-validated (libauth BCH-2026) before broadcast. A 10-unit test op preceded it: c8bb80db02ef0196180ccb1c8b6db54fdcbcb0be5028396e1afac00a9708e679. NOT production: Gate-7 public ceremony still required.
